in_scope.instructions:
**1win Partners** - the official 1win affiliate program, owned and operated by 1win.

In scope:
- Partner registration and login
- Partner dashboard: statistics, promo tools, payment details, payouts
- Referral links, attribution and postbacks
- Partner API and Telegram bot

The same service runs on 1w.run, 1win-partners.com, 1win.partners, 1win.run, 1w-partner.com and 1win.team. Report issues found on any of them under 1w.run or 1win-partners.com; both are accepted.

Payout manipulation and hijacking of referral attribution are rated under the financial rows of the reward table (¹).

**1win Forum** - the official 1win community forum (self-hosted Invision Community). Also available at forum.1win.com; report issues found there under this asset.
